title: Unit Event — On the Stage of Dazzling Light — Episode1 To the Music Hall!

meta.Event: On the Stage of Dazzling Light
meta.Event Outline: Ever since his visit to Riley Dream Park, Tsukasa has felt a desire to improve even more as an actor. In the troupe's new ambassadorial show, he takes on a character unlike any he has before, with a personality entirely opposite his own.

rows.Line: Tsukasa's Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Why do we have to fight each other?!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Dad... Please don't make me do this!”
se_event_star_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, that felt good...
Let's see how it looks on video.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hmm... Something seems off.
Even after Rui went through the trouble of translating this for me...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The show we saw at Riley Dream Park felt so much more powerful and compelling.

rows.Speaker: King
rows.Line: “Come on, stab me in the heart!”

rows.Speaker: Prince
rows.Line: “Dad...Please don't make me do this!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Their sheer acting ability...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So this is a world-class cast...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Not only were the leads in their element, but the other cast members were also just as spectacular.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (If I'm going to have any hope of becoming a world-famous star, I'll have to find a way to raise my acting ability to at least their level...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, once more!
Reset my phone and...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Why do we have to fight each other?!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Dad... Please don't make me do this!”
se_event_star_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
How's that?!
I must've nailed that one! Let's take a look!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No! All wrong!
My delivery sounds so unrefined and lacks any kind of depth. How can I match what I saw that time?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmmmm... Alright, again!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Why do we have to fight each other?!”

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line:
Tsukasa, keep it down!
We can hear you from the living room!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What?!
S-Sorry...
se_event_star_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
This isn't going as well as I'd hoped...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In times like this, it might be good to...
The next day
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Now that we're all here, I'll start explaining more about your next show assignment as ambassadors.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Question!
Where are we going next♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: These discussions feel really commonplace now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I think it's exciting to hear from them since we always get to go somewhere new with each show.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anyway, where's our next destination...?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: The Special Stage at Central City Park...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The Special Stage at Central City Park?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know that place! It's the really, really big stage at the really, really big park, right?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. It's also a place where world-famous stars performed when they were just starting out...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And we, at long last, get to perform there...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Well, that was the original plan...
Unfortunately, it has to undergo renovations starting next week to mend any age-related wear and tear.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: As a result, you'll be performing in the music hall located just near the Special Stage.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: B-B-But...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Why do you sound so disappointed?
That music hall's pretty big on top of being really nice.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I know... But my expectations skyrocketed just now and... Guh...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
The music hall, eh...?
We have been performing outside for so long that this could be a nice change to try some new things.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I agree. They even said you can borrow any of their props as long as you ask in advance.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Here's their inventory list.
If anything catches your eye, I say ask and see what they think.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Ah, they've made some of their instruments available to us...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Anyway, now that we know where we'll be performing and what we can use, let's start thinking about what we're gonna do.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!!
bgm_area00004
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, let's start discussing what we'll be doing for our next show!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: A show at a music hall sounds like fun! Why not work some songs into your performance?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Some songs...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I wanna play the tambourine!
And I also wanna shake-shake-shake the maracas!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rather predictable choices...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'll play the castanets!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'll play the recorder!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. Sounds like your troupe's turning into a band.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I can only sort of play the instruments I learned at school...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Same. The most I've really done is build some electric instruments for a show...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What? That's incredible...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Tsukasa, can't you play the piano?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, I can.
My mom's a piano teacher and I've been learning from her since I was little.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right!
Your mom's a piano teacher!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. I've even performed in some minor contests based on her suggestion!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But that's been on the sidelines ever since I decided to become a star... Although, I did use to practice quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I had no idea... I take it you can play pretty well.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, I know...
Why don't we do “A Pianist Named Thorpe”?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A pianist named... Wait, I've heard of that before.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
It's a very famous novella.
It's even been turned into an audio play, so there's a script already available. However...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: However...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa may have a hard time playing the role of Thorpe.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh? What do you mean?
He can play the piano. Doesn't that make him the perfect candidate?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
True...
Why don't we give it a quick try since we're on the topic?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, can we join you?!
Please, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I'll have a hard time... Why?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (What did he mean by that...?)
